custom_qzkay8wp.name: Custom L-Shaped Stair

custom_geometry.code: const group = new THREE.Group(); const stepHeight = 0.2; const stepDepth = 0.3; const stepWidth = 1.5; const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0x555555}); for(let i=0; i<5; i++) { const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(stepWidth, stepHeight, stepDepth); const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat); mesh.position.set(0, i*stepHeight + stepHeight/2, i*stepDepth + stepDepth/2); group.add(mesh); } const landingGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(stepWidth, stepHeight, stepWidth); const landing = new THREE.Mesh(landingGeo, mat); landing.position.set(0, 5*stepHeight + stepHeight/2, 5*stepDepth + stepWidth/2); group.add(landing); for(let i=1; i<=5; i++) { const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(stepDepth, stepHeight, stepWidth); const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat); mesh.position.set(i*stepDepth + stepWidth/2 - stepDepth/2, (i+5)*stepHeight + stepHeight/2, 5*stepDepth + stepWidth/2); group.add(mesh); } return group;

custom_qq6t15mz.name: Custom Quarter-Turn Stair

custom_geometry.code: const group = new THREE.Group(); const stepHeight = 0.2; const innerRadius = 0.5; const outerRadius = 2.0; const steps = 8; const anglePerStep = (Math.PI / 2) / steps; const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0x777777}); for(let i=0; i<steps; i++) { const shape = new THREE.Shape(); shape.moveTo(innerRadius * Math.cos(i*anglePerStep), innerRadius * Math.sin(i*anglePerStep)); shape.lineTo(outerRadius * Math.cos(i*anglePerStep), outerRadius * Math.sin(i*anglePerStep)); shape.lineTo(outerRadius * Math.cos((i+1)*anglePerStep), outerRadius * Math.sin((i+1)*anglePerStep)); shape.lineTo(innerRadius * Math.cos((i+1)*anglePerStep), innerRadius * Math.sin((i+1)*anglePerStep)); shape.lineTo(innerRadius * Math.cos(i*anglePerStep), innerRadius * Math.sin(i*anglePerStep)); const extrudeSettings = { depth: stepHeight, bevelEnabled: false }; const geo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, extrudeSettings); const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat); mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; mesh.position.y = i * stepHeight; group.add(mesh); } return group;

custom_5mypxq1t.name: Custom Wall with Hole and Bulb

custom_geometry.code: const group = new THREE.Group(); const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0x883333}); const shape = new THREE.Shape(); shape.moveTo(-2, 0); shape.lineTo(2, 0); shape.lineTo(2, 3); shape.lineTo(-2, 3); shape.lineTo(-2, 0); const hole = new THREE.Path(); hole.moveTo(-0.5, 1); hole.lineTo(0.5, 1); hole.lineTo(0.5, 2); hole.lineTo(-0.5, 2); hole.lineTo(-0.5, 1); shape.holes.push(hole); const extrudeSettings = { depth: 0.3, bevelEnabled: true, bevelThickness: 0.05 }; const wallGeo = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, extrudeSettings); const wallMesh = new THREE.Mesh(wallGeo, mat); group.add(wallMesh); const bulbGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.4, 32, 32); const bulbMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color: 0xffff00, emissive: 0xaaaa00}); const bulbMesh = new THREE.Mesh(bulbGeo, bulbMat); bulbMesh.position.set(1, 1.5, 0.15); group.add(bulbMesh); return group;
